summary: Feature request to add optional retry policies for PayloadCodec Encode/Decode operations. Currently, codec failures from external services (KMS, HTTP sidecars, schema registries) immediately abort the entire operation; users must implement retry logic independently for each codec. The proposal adds CodecDataConverterWithOptions allowing per-codec retry policies with configurable backoff.
userImpact: Users implementing external-service-calling codecs must either duplicate retry logic internally or use undocumented techniques like panicking to trigger SDK-level retries.
rootCause: The SDK has no built-in retry mechanism for codec failures; each codec must independently handle transient errors or the entire encode/decode operation fails.
proposedFix: Add NewCodecDataConverterWithOptions with CodecDataConverterOptions containing optional RetryPolicy, IsRetryable predicate, and Context; implement per-codec retry with independent boundaries.
workaround: Wrap codec body in defer/recover and panic(err) on transient errors to leverage SDK's coroutine recovery mechanism (undocumented, depends on internal SDK behavior).
keyQuote: Each downstream user has to either fork the codec or wrap retry logic inside their own codec implementation, which duplicates effort
